name: Blush Studios LLC
address: 48 Mamaroneck Ave, White Plains, NY 10601, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Amanda Jewel
reviewSamples.text:
Mariah at Blush Studios LLC is absolutely amazing. From the moment my family and I walked in, she welcomed us so warmly and immediately made us feel comfortable. Even with our very inquisitive 2-year-old, she was patient, kind, and knew exactly how to work with all of us so the experience felt relaxed and fun.

She created such a great environment where we could just be ourselves in front of the camera and truly enjoy the moment. The session felt natural and joyful, and that really shows in the photos.

The pictures she captured are beautiful, and her editing is incredible. We left the studio feeling so happy and excited to see how everything would turn out, and when we received the photos we were beyond thrilled. She did an amazing job and we are so happy with them.

I highly recommend Blush Studios LLC to anyone looking for a photographer who is talented, welcoming, and truly cares about capturing special moments.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of CynthiaLaCruz
reviewSamples.text: I am so grateful for this space and the Blush studio staff.  I really needed new headshots, but was hesitating because I had been going through Cancer treatment. Mariah, the Studio Owner was so patient and understanding. She took her timing making sure we got the best angles, helped me with adjusting my make-up when she saw anything on the camera. I felt very safe, supported, and it was fun experience.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michelle VanNess
reviewSamples.text: Mariah was absolutely amazing from start to finish! It had been a very long time since I had updated my headshots & she made the experience fun and stress-free. She was very professional, was fast with communication & delivered a high quality product. Highly recommended!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Justis Starks
reviewSamples.text: Amazing experience for my birthday photos!! Very attentive, creative and executed my vision perfectly

reviewSamples.author: Photo of shane samuels
reviewSamples.text: Blush Studios offers a fantastic setting for both photo and video shoots. The owner, Mariah, is an exemplary host—attentive and reliable, making every interaction smooth and pleasant. Booking is hassle-free, and the quality of the photos is consistently great. This studio is highly recommended for anyone seeking a professional and accommodating environment for their creative projects.
